body_sans.usage: Form inputs, countdown numbers, small details
body_sans.classes: font-['Montserrat'] tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-xs to text-sm

motifs.rose_petals: Framer Motion animated SVG paths of petals falling and swaying softly.
motifs.drifting_leaves: SVG leaves translating diagonally across the screen with varying rotation.
motifs.gold_dust: Small div circles with accent color and blur, blinking opacity and drifting upwards.
motifs.soft_clouds: Layered SVG paths with opacity translating slowly across the X-axis.
motifs.gold_shimmer_particles: Denser gold_dust with a mix of scale and blurred glowing trails (drop-shadow).
motifs.stardust_bokeh: Overlapping blurred circles with CSS radial gradients fading in and out.
motifs.water_caustics: SVG radial gradients swaying horizontally to simulate underwater light.
motifs.marble_veins_animated: SVG feTurbulence filter moving slowly via baseFrequency animation to simulate living marble.

premium_distinctions.free: Flat colors, subtle CSS motifs, standard framer-motion transitions, solid shapes.
premium_distinctions.premium: Textured backgrounds (using CSS noise or SVG filters), animated metallic gradients (background-clip: text), layered glassmorphism cards (backdrop-blur-xl), interactive hover/touch particle generation.

stages: 1. Loader: Monogram initials elegantly pulsing in the center.
2. Envelope Reveal: A full-screen CSS-drawn envelope (using borders to create flaps).
3. Flap Opening: The top triangle of the envelope rotates open (rotateX(180deg) with origin at top).
4. Card Extraction: The invitation content slides up from inside the envelope, scaling to full screen.
5. Envelope Fade: The envelope fades out, leaving the guest on the Hero section.

hero.structure: Full height (min-h-[90vh]) flex-col center. Top: 'Sizleri Bekliyoruz' (Serif, small). Center: Monogram / Names in Script (massive, overlapping elements). Bottom: Date (Sans, uppercase, tracked out).
hero.styling: Absolute positioned motif layer (z-0), Content layer (z-10). Use negative space generously.

countdown.styling: Premium themes: Glassmorphism background (backdrop-blur-md, bg-white/10), 1px solid border of accent color. Free: Solid soft background. Number in Serif, Label in tiny Sans.

details.structure: Card layout. Icon top, Title, Time, Location Name, Address, Map button.
details.styling: Inner shadow or soft drop shadow. Rounded elegant corners (rounded-t-full arch shape is highly recommended for premium feel). Give generous padding (p-8 or p-10).

rsvp.structure: Stack of elegant inputs. Name, Attendance status, Count, Dietary/Message.
rsvp.styling: Inputs should have bottom border ONLY (border-b border-accent/50), no full box border, background transparent. It must feel like writing on physical premium paper.

memory_wall.structure: Vertical list of small messages, slightly overlapping or offset.
memory_wall.styling: Post-it or elegant card style. Include cursive font for the messages.

gift_iban.structure: Accordions or minimal flip-cards to hide IBANs until clicked.
gift_iban.styling: Minimal, using monospace for IBAN. Include a 'Copy' button with a subtle SVG icon. No heavy borders.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the Digital Invitation Guest Page as a standalone mobile-first view (no site header/footer).
Implement pure CSS and framer-motion animations. Do not rely on external image assets for themes (except pure SVG paths for motifs).
Load 'Great Vibes', 'Cormorant Garamond', and 'Montserrat' fonts from Google Fonts in the CSS file.
Build a ThemeProvider context or use CSS variables to switch palettes based on the active theme.
Implement the Envelope Opening sequence as a standalone Framer Motion component that reveals the main content upon opening.
Ensure the RSVP inputs look like physical paper lines (bottom borders only). Avoid generic Shadcn default input borders.
Add an audio element for background music with a floating play/pause FAB (Floating Action Button) fixed at the bottom right corner.
Ensure all interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Never use generic centered layouts globally. Balance asymmetry to create visual tension.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for overlays where text becomes unreadable. Ensure contrast (APCA standards).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, transitions). Static is dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use Phosphor icons or lucide-react for iconography.
Use sonner for elegant toast notifications (e.g., 'IBAN Kopyalandı', 'LCV Gönderildi').
Do NOT use placeholder text or generic AI emoji.
